main.description: Create a new post in a community

community.description: Community identifier (DID, handle, name@origin, or bare local name) of the community to post in

content.description: Post content - supports rich text via facets

facets.description: Annotations for rich text (mentions, links, formatting, block structure)

embed.description: Embedded media, external links, or quoted posts

langs.description: Languages used in the post content (ISO 639-1)

status.description: The community's decision as of this response. 'accepted' means this host runs the community's admission and a community acceptance now stands for the post; 'pending' means no acceptance covers it yet - either the community is hosted elsewhere and decides for itself, or the synchronous acceptance failed and will be retried. Pending is a SUCCESS, not an error: the post exists in its author's repository either way. Optional, so a client predating the field decodes an unchanged response. knownValues rather than an enum because the vocabulary may grow, and a closed enum would make adding a status a breaking change for every generated client in the network.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: User is not authorized to post in this community

errors.name: Banned
errors.description: User is banned from this community

errors.name: ContentRuleViolation
errors.description: Post violates community content rules (e.g., embeds not allowed, text too short)
